node.title: Re: PERL REST API Post script
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I am trying to use arguments to pass information from the command line into a perl script. These are the IP, Email, the User and the password. The IP works but the rest does not get parsed into the req for the content. If I hardcode these the script works.

Use either [doc://Data::Dumper] with $Data::Dumper::Useqq=1; or [mod://Data::Dump] to inspect the variables you're getting from the command line, and check that they are as you expect. (Also, it looks like you're generating JSON by pasting a string together, I'd very much recommend one of the JSON modules instead, such as [mod://Cpanel::JSON::XS].)
